text: The most attractive thing about you should be your standards. Know what you want and refuse to settle for less.
author: Unknown

text: You attract what you are, not what you want. If you want great love, become a great love.
author: Unknown

text: The right person will find you more attractive the more yourself you become.
author: Unknown

text: Stop shrinking yourself to seem less intimidating. The person worth having won't be threatened by your wholeness.
author: Unknown

text: Work on being the person you'd want to fall in love with.
author: Unknown

text: You don't find love by chasing it. You find it by building a life so full that love has somewhere worth landing.
author: Unknown

text: Confidence isn't thinking you're better than everyone. It's knowing you don't need anyone to complete you — only to complement you.
author: Unknown

text: The energy you bring into a room is the energy you invite into your life.
author: Unknown

text: Before you look for a partner, look at the partnership you have with yourself. That one sets the tone for everything else.
author: Unknown

text: Desperation is invisible until it isn't. When you're at peace with being alone, the right person notices.
author: Unknown

text: Love yourself so fiercely that anyone who wants to be in your life has to rise to meet you.
author: Unknown

text: The goal isn't to find someone to love you. The goal is to become someone you love — and let the rest follow.
author: Unknown

text: Your standards are not too high. You've just met too many people willing to offer too little.
author: Unknown

text: The most magnetic version of you is the one who isn't performing for anyone.
author: Unknown

text: To attract a loving relationship, you must first believe you deserve one.
author: Unknown

text: People are drawn to those who are fully alive. Live your life so loudly that love can find you by the sound of it.
author: Unknown

text: You will never outrun your self-image in relationships. Whatever you believe you deserve is what you'll accept.
author: Unknown

text: Stop being available to people who are only available when it's convenient for them.
author: Unknown

text: The version of you that has done the work, knows their worth, and leads with peace — that person is irresistible.
author: Unknown

text: Stop texting first for a week. You'll learn everything you need to know.
author: Unknown

text: Don't chase, attract.
author: Unknown

text: If they didn't choose you then, make sure they can't have you now.
author: Unknown

text: The best response to rejection is becoming so undeniable that they remember the moment they said no.
author: Unknown

text: Love finds you when you find yourself.
author: Unknown

text: You attract what you believe you deserve.
author: Unknown

text: Open your heart. Love is already near.
author: Unknown

text: The right love won't feel like a battle.
author: Unknown

text: You are magnetic. Trust the pull.
author: Unknown

text: Love begins with the energy you carry.
author: Unknown

text: Your heart knows who it's waiting for.
author: Unknown

text: Be the love you want to receive.
author: Unknown

text: Love arrives when you stop forcing it.
author: Unknown

text: The right person will stay.
author: Unknown

text: Love grows where honesty lives.
author: Unknown

text: You deserve love without confusion.
author: Unknown

text: Real love doesn't make you guess.
author: Unknown

text: Your energy introduces you first.
author: Unknown

text: Stop looking. Start becoming.
author: Unknown

text: Healthy love feels like breathing.
author: Unknown

text: You were made to be chosen.
author: Unknown

text: Love isn't earned. It's recognized.
author: Unknown

text: What's meant for you will find you.
author: Unknown

text: Dress like you're about to meet the one.
author: Unknown

text: Your confidence is your best perfume.
author: Unknown

text: Smile first. Love follows.
author: Unknown

text: Walk in like you own the room.
author: Unknown

text: Be the energy you want to attract.
author: Unknown

text: Love yourself so loud they notice.
author: Unknown

text: Glow so bright they can't look away.
author: Unknown

text: Your laugh is someone's favorite sound.
author: Unknown

text: Be magnetic. Be unapologetic.
author: Unknown

text: Show up as the best version of you.
author: Unknown

text: Radiate warmth. Love will come.
author: Unknown

text: Let your happiness attract them.
author: Unknown

text: Be whole first. Love adds, not completes.
author: Unknown

text: Live fully. The right one will notice.
author: Unknown

text: Your energy speaks before your words do.
author: Unknown

text: Flirt with life. Love gets jealous.
author: Unknown

text: Dance like they're watching. They are.
author: Unknown

text: Be so good they can't ignore you.
author: Unknown
